Normalization tests - DIA-NN protein groups%%00010%%00010Comparison of different normalization methods (median, quantile, loessF and vsn), as well as of normalization performed previously in DIA-NN. Different data can be selected for the normalization techniquest to be compared on them. %%00010It is possible to visualize both the normalized and not normalized data using several types of plots (violin plots, MA plots, correlation clustermaps...). These plots are saved in the _outputs_ subfolder inside the folder for a given KNIME project. It is also possible to visualize only a certain subset of the data, e. g. only replicates of a given sample. %%00010It is also necessary to run previous Sample name extraction results of which will be used for calling the required columns within the metanode. %%00010Within the metanode, it is also possible to change certain plot parameters for all types of plots. The metanode needs to be disconnected before changing these parameters. %%00010%%00010The main purpose of this metanode is to assist with the automated generation of figures used for the different normalization approaches quality control and selection of an appropriate normalization method.
